fixture.originalDraft:
In June 2026, Partners Group made a commitment to Meridian Capital Partners V, a EUR 1.2 billion fund targeting lower-mid-market buyouts in European industrial technology and business services.

The fund is managed by Meridian Capital Management, which has deployed EUR 2.8 billion across 41 platform investments over Funds I to IV and has realised a gross MOIC of 2.4 times and a gross IRR of 21 per cent across 17 fully realised exits.

Fund IV, the 2019 vintage fund of EUR 900 million, is currently marked at 1.9 times gross MOIC to date.

Partners Group was attracted to this investment given Meridian Capital's strong track record on its prior vintage funds, coupled with its well-established and highly regarded investment team and operational approach to value creation.

The investment team comprises 14 professionals across London, Munich and Stockholm, the founding partners have worked together since 2008, and diligence has confirmed no senior departures across the last three fund cycles relative to peers.

Partners Group expects the relationship to deepen over the life of the fund.
